data.one_liner: A 3D carousel widget with roll, pitch, and yaw animations for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a carousel that can rotate in three dimensions, responding to button clicks and swipe gestures. Developers can customize radius, roll, pitch, yaw, and child orientation to create immersive UI effects.
use_when: You need a depth‑aware carousel to showcase items with 3‑D motion
You want built‑in gesture handling for rotating content
You prefer a single‑purpose widget rather than building the math yourself
avoid_when: Performance is critical for very large numbers of children
You only need a simple 2‑D list or grid
You require extensive snapping or pagination features not yet supported
strengths: Three degrees of freedom (roll, pitch, yaw)
Works on all major Flutter platforms
weaknesses: Potential performance impact with many children
Documentation focuses on examples, fewer API details
